notes.zh: 考勤修正：旧班次在排班下班时间两小时后自动记为缺下班卡，新一天可正常开始；打卡前先确认班次状态，避免定位重试与下班提示冲突。包含排班当天发布与聊天分享、@提醒与聊天刷新、任务发布及服务恢复优化。
notes.en: Attendance fix: unfinished shifts become missing clock-out two hours after scheduled end, and clock-in checks the current shift before requesting location. Also includes schedule sharing, mention/chat refresh, task publishing and service recovery improvements.
